title: Thousands more Japanese cards
items: About 12,000 Japanese cards TCGdex was missing are added from the official Japanese card list (everything since Diamond & Pearl), with pictures
Empty Japanese sets like Shiny Star V and Shining Darkness now have their cards
Japanese decks, gift sets and promo lists are added as their own sets, with names
Japanese cards without a picture now show the official one
Scanning covers the added Japanese cards (once the scan data finishes building)
"What's new" notes like this one after each update (also in Settings)

title: Japanese cards back on TCGdex
items: Japanese sets come from TCGdex again; your cards were moved across
No more duplicated empty sets (TCGdex placeholders are skipped)
English and Japanese versions of old cards now combine in the Pokédex (Japanese sets often came out up to 3 years earlier)
A version with no picture borrows its twin's picture (same artwork)

title: Search, binders and prices
items: Search by card number, e.g. "Mewtwo 164/162" or "#25"
Drag cards between binder pockets and pages (long-press a card)
eBay sold prices read through a hidden browser inside the app (needs the new APK)
New card lists are picked up automatically at start-up
